# Flightdesk UK name and logo policy

This policy is separate from the AGPL-3.0-only code licence. It does not restrict commercial use, lawful forks or the code permissions granted by AGPL.

Subject to confirmed ownership and applicable law, Flightdesk UK, project logos and ENDIAN-LAB branding identify official project releases. No registered-trademark claim is made. Brand owner/contact: pending confirmation by the project owner.

Unchanged official copies may retain their existing branding and notices when accurately identified. Independently modified distributions and hosted versions should use their own prominent product identity and clearly identify independent maintenance, unless the confirmed brand owner permits official branding. They may state truthfully “Based on Flightdesk UK”, link to the original project and preserve required legal notices. Do not imply endorsement by the original project or Imperial.

Truthful descriptive references, compatibility statements, links, legally permitted nominative use and required source attribution remain permitted. This is not a mandatory advertising requirement. Applicable law and pre-existing permissions remain unaffected.

## Artwork

The app icon assets are dist/icons/icon-180.png, icon-192.png and icon-512.png; their authorship and copyright ownership have not been independently confirmed. To the extent the project owner controls these assets, permission is granted to reproduce them unchanged in unchanged official copies and their installation materials. Other logo/artwork reuse requires permission from the actual rights holder unless already licensed or permitted by law. Third-party logos and Leaflet images retain their own rights/licences; this policy does not reserve them.

Confirm ownership/contact and any existing artwork permissions before asserting exclusive rights or publishing a final brand policy.
